title: The Great Birthday Cake Quest
tagline: The birthday cake has vanished. Follow the clues to find it!

checklist: Print and cut the clue cards
Hide Clue #2 through #10 using the hiding spot guide
Put the Quest Complete card by the cake
Keep Clue #1 in your hand to start

intro.speaker: knight
lines: Today is no ordinary birthday. Something mysterious has happened in the kingdom!
Somewhere inside this house, a clever hiding place waits to be discovered. But finding it will not be easy.
Only the bravest explorers can solve the clues. Search high. Search low. Follow the clues wherever they go!
So gather your courage. Your first clue is waiting...

steps.speaker: princess
steps.riddle: Your quest begins, the search is on! They go on your feet when you head out to play. Look where they wait at the end of the day!
steps.hint: Check by the front door, where shoes go.

steps.speaker: knight
steps.riddle: You're off to a start, you're doing great! It hums all day and it's cold inside. That's where the milk and the juice all hide!

steps.speaker: princess
steps.riddle: Brave adventurers follow the trail. Grab some popcorn and cuddle in tight. Where do you watch a movie at night?
steps.hint: Where do you watch shows? Check the TV or couch.

steps.speaker: knight
steps.riddle: Through castle halls your quest must flow. Turn the handle and water will go. Bubbles and soap, scrub-a-dub-dee. Wash your hands and you will see!
steps.hint: Where do you wash your hands?

steps.speaker: princess
steps.riddle: Your quest continues, don't delay! Where do the blocks and the teddies stay?

steps.speaker: knight
steps.riddle: The trail grows warm, you're almost there! Where do you snuggle and dream each night, under the blanket, tucked in tight?
steps.hint: Check a bed or under a pillow.

steps.speaker: princess
steps.riddle: Even heroes need a treat. Where does your family sit down to eat?
steps.hint: Try the kitchen table or the spoon drawer.

steps.speaker: knight
steps.riddle: The adventure spins with a splash and swirl. Dirty socks go in, then round they twirl!

steps.speaker: knight
steps.riddle: Just one more clue, you're almost there! Find where the stories rest in a row, with pages and pictures ready to go.

steps.speaker: princess
steps.riddle: You followed the clues with courage and might. The birthday treasure is now in sight! Look where the birthday cake waits in delight.
steps.hint: Where would a birthday cake be waiting?

found: You found it! Great detective work!
Amazing! The kingdom is proud of you!

finale.title: Quest Complete!
lines: You did it! The birthday treasure has been found!
finale.artAlt: The knight and princess celebrating with the cake

print.subtitle: A printable birthday adventure where kids follow clues to discover the hidden cake.
coverFeatures: Quest Master on your phone: reads the clues, gives hints, throws the confetti
Blank cards for your own hiding spots
storyLines: something mysterious has happened in the kingdom.
Somewhere inside this house, a clever hiding place waits to be discovered. But finding it will not be easy.
Only the bravest explorers will be able to solve the clues.
Each riddle will lead you closer. Each discovery will bring you nearer to the hidden treasure.
Search high. Search low. Follow the clues wherever they go.
And if you are brave enough... you just might discover the hidden birthday cake!
So gather your courage. Your first clue is waiting...
print.storyCall: Let the Birthday Cake Quest begin!

storyAside.speaker: knight
storyAside.text: Hurry! The first clue is already in your hands...

startCard.speaker: princess
startCard.title: A Quest Begins!
startCard.text: Brave explorer, your quest begins! Follow the clues and search high and low. A birthday treasure is waiting for you!

print.parentTip: Dim the lights a little and play some quest music. It makes the whole house feel like a castle.

tips.title: Create a craft station
tips.text: Before the quest begins, let young adventurers make their own royal gear while everyone arrives.
list: Paper tubes for wands or swords
tips.note: Skip the glitter. Future you will thank you.

tips.title: Set the scene
list: Play quest music while explorers search
Give the birthday child a title, like Royal Birthday Explorer
Pretend the house is a castle with secret rooms, and add a small cardboard hidden door

tips.title: Serve knightly snacks
tips.text: Save these for after the treasure is found.
list: Magic Potion Punch: butterfly pea tea lemonade
Royal Wands: pretzel rods dipped in frosting and sprinkles
Knightly Snacks: cheese cubes, grapes, or popcorn

tips.title: Celebrate the treasure
tips.text: When the last clue leads to the cake, declare it loudly: "Quest complete! The birthday treasure has been found!" Then hand out certificates and cut the cake.

certificate.title: Royal Birthday Explorer
certificate.body: for bravely solving every clue and finding the hidden birthday cake.
